title: Data Retention
intro: Configure automatic cleanup of stale data, or run a cleanup manually right now. Active/in-progress data (pending requests, active bans, active sessions) is never deleted regardless of the retention period.

categories.accessRequestsTip: Only requests with status "denied" are deleted. Pending, approved, and granted requests are never deleted.
categories.loginAttemptsTip: The login attempt log (successful and failed), used for statistics.
categories.loginBansTip: Only already-expired bans are deleted. An active or future ban is never deleted.

cleanupNow.confirmContent: This deletes denied requests, and old audit/login-attempt/ban rows per the retention periods above (regardless of the toggles), plus expired login sessions.
cleanupNow.result: Done: requests — {{accessRequests}}, audit — {{auditLog}}, login attempts — {{loginAttempts}}, bans — {{loginBans}}, sessions — {{sessions}}
